title: Crux Resolve GhostBridge GB-01 RS232 to WiFi TCP Serial Bridge
description: GhostBridge GB-01 is an assembled local RS232-to-WiFi TCP bridge designed for reliable local serial communication. It is optimized and verified for the GhostTune workflow with MicroSquirt hardware running MS2/Extra 3.4.4, and can also serve compatible serial applications when electrical, cabling, serial, and software requirements match.
